name: Koroshi no Dress 3
source:
Follows the efforts of a certain police detective Mashiba who finds himself drawn into a difficult murder case with multiple suspects but few initial leads.

In the meanwhile, more murders cut through the city.
Is this the work of the same killer as the previous one and the ones before it that have been making the headlines recently?

The investigation reveals a complex web of interpersonal connections in the shadows of the case as the personal lives of people involved with the victim Toshiya Kanzaki are laid bare by Mashiba's work.

After a painstaking and arduous investigation, will he be able to identify the culprit?

[Edited from the [url=https://fandc.co.jp/catalog/pc/226]official website[/url]]
translation:
刑警真柴悟被卷入一桩棘手的谋杀案。嫌疑人众多，最初能掌握的线索却少之又少。

与此同时，城里又接连发生命案。凶手是否与前一案相同，甚至就是近期屡屡登上新闻的连续杀人犯？

随着真柴展开调查，受害者神崎敏哉身边人的私生活逐一曝光，案件背后错综复杂的人际关系也浮出水面。

历经艰苦而漫长的追查后，他能否辨明真正的凶手？

[据[url=https://fandc.co.jp/catalog/pc/226]官方网站[/url]编辑]
